title: As-Salah with Mahabbah, Not Compulsion
summary: By the age of ten, the command regarding salah intensifies, yet compulsion alone breeds aversion. Connect salah to serenity and the meeting with Allah. Pray before him with visible khushu’, and praise his commitment without a sense of minn (favour). Love establishes what coercion cannot.
try_this: This week: Pray one salah beside your son with evident khushu’, then speak together afterwards about the meaning of standing in the presence of Allah.
reflection_prompts: How does your son perform his salah now?
Does he see it as a heavy duty or as a meeting?

review_defects.english: Pray before him with visible khushu’
review_defects.why: The Arabic does not include 'ظاهر' (visible). The English adds 'visible' which is not in the source text. The try_this section does contain 'بخشوعٍ ظاهر', but the summary does not.
